name: Still Water
description: A calm water surface behind your content: the pointer presses ripples into it as it moves, a click drops a stone, and now and then a raindrop lands.

props.name: damping
props.description: How much of each ripple survives a sixtieth of a second. Lower settles faster; 0.995 rings for a long time.

props.name: strength
props.description: How hard the pointer presses on the surface. 0 turns the pointer and clicks off.

props.name: rain
props.description: Let a raindrop land somewhere every few seconds.

props.name: rainInterval
props.description: Average time between raindrops, in milliseconds.

props.name: resolution
props.description: Cells across the simulation grid. The surface is shaded smoothly at full resolution whatever the grid.

props.name: tint
props.description: Colour of the water. Any CSS colour or token.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which is relative and clips the water. Other div props are passed through.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered above the water. The pointer still moves the water through it.
